MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 8
   C. 49
   D. 7

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

3. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

5. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

7. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

8. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 7
   C. 6
   D. 18

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 33
   C. 28
   D. 22

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 30

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 44
   C. 105
   D. 22

15. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 22
   C. 77
   D. 36

17. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

18. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

19. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

20. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

21. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

22. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 15
   C. 7
   D. 17

23. Solve for x: x + 4 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 11
   D. 14

24. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

25. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

26. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

27. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

28. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

29. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 1

30. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
